Three-bean chili

Original EZEATS recipe · editorially reviewed draft · owner review required · not kitchen-tested.

Three kinds of beans make a thick tomato chili with gentle heat.

Tex-Mex-inspired · dinner, soup · easy

Servings: 4

Prep: 10 min

Cook: 25 min

Total: 35 min (estimate)

Estimated cost: USD 4 per serving. Not a price quote or a CAD conversion.

Diet and allergy suitability: unverified. Ingredient-list screening only, for the exact products specified. Brands, substitutions and cross-contact can change suitability. Editorial review is not kitchen testing or a medical or allergy-safety guarantee.

Known allergens: No listed major allergens. This list may be incomplete; check package labels and cross-contact.

Before you cook

  • Before starting, wash hands with soap and water for 20 seconds. Rinse fresh produce under running water and use clean utensils.
  • Check every packaged ingredient label for dietary requirements and allergens, including cross-contact notices. Choose products with no additional allergenic ingredients beyond the warnings listed here; otherwise these ingredient-based recommendations no longer apply. Listed tags apply only to the specified ingredients; they are not allergy-safe guarantees.
  • Refrigerate perishable ingredients until needed. Refrigerate leftovers in shallow containers within 2 hours (within 1 hour above 90°F/32°C); reheat leftovers to 74°C/165°F.

Ingredients

  • 1 1/2 cups canned kidney beans (Drained and rinsed; quantities are drained. Check package labels; use the specified dietary version and check additional allergens and cross-contact notices.)
  • 1 1/2 cups canned black beans (Drained and rinsed; quantities are drained. Check package labels; use the specified dietary version and check additional allergens and cross-contact notices.)
  • 1 1/2 cups canned pinto beans (Drained and rinsed; quantities are drained. Check package labels; use the specified dietary version and check additional allergens and cross-contact notices.)
  • 3 cups canned diced tomatoes (Include juices. Check package labels; use the specified dietary version and check additional allergens and cross-contact notices.)
  • 1 medium yellow onion (diced)
  • 2 teaspoons mild gluten-free chili powder (Choose a dairy-free blend. Check package labels; use the specified dietary version and check additional allergens and cross-contact notices.)
  • 1 tablespoon olive oil
  • 1/2 cup water
  • 1/4 teaspoon fine salt

Cooking instructions

  1. Heat the olive oil in a heavy pot on medium. Add the yellow onion and cook for 5 minutes, stirring until translucent.
  2. Stir in the mild gluten-free chili powder for 30 seconds. Add the canned diced tomatoes, water and fine salt and bring to a gentle simmer.
  3. Add the canned kidney beans, canned black beans and canned pinto beans. Simmer uncovered for 18 minutes, stirring from the bottom so nothing catches.
  4. Mash a scoop of beans against the pot to thicken, stir it back in and ladle into four bowls.
